The '''1990 FA Charity Shield''' (also known as the '''[[Wellpark Brewery|Tennent's]] FA Charity Shield''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 68th [[FA Community Shield|Charity Shield]], a [[association football|football]] match contested by the winners of the previous season's [[The Football League|Football League]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. The match was played on 18 August 1990 between [[1989–90 Football League]] champions [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] and [[1989–90 FA Cup]] winners [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]]. 

Utility player [[Clayton Blackmore]] opened the scoring for United in the first half, but a [[John Barnes (footballer)|John Barnes]] [[Penalty kick (association football)|penalty kick]] drew Liverpool level shortly after the break. The match finished at 1–1 and the two sides shared the trophy for six months each.

Absent from the game for Manchester United were captain [[Bryan Robson]], who would be out of action until December that year due to injury; left-back [[Lee Martin (footballer, born February 1968)|Lee Martin]] who scored the winning goal in the FA Cup Final three months previously; and midfielder [[Neil Webb]]. Their places in the starting XI were taken by [[Clayton Blackmore]], [[Mal Donaghy]] and newly signed full-back from [[Oldham Athletic A.F.C.|Oldham]], [[Denis Irwin]], beginning a 12-year spell with the club that would reap numerous honours, while [[Paul Ince]] moved back into his usual midfield position.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://manchesterunitedlegends.wordpress.com/2010/01/17/bryan-robson-1981-1994-461-games-97-goals/|title = Bryan Robson 1981-1994 461 Games 97 Goals|date = 17 January 2010}}</ref>

As a curtain-raiser to the match, the [[England women's national football team]] played [[Italy women's national football team|Italy]]. [[Carolina Morace]] scored all four goals in England's 4–1 defeat and made it onto the front page of the following day's [[La Gazzetta dello Sport]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Carolina Morace, quattro gol per far girare la testa a Wembley |publisher=[[La Gazzetta dello Sport]] |first=Tiziana |last=Bottazzo |url=http://www.calciodonna.it/Carolina/gazzetta.htm |access-date=28 September 2011 |date=19 August 1990 }}</ref>
